clientId.title: Client Id
clientId.description: A virtual client id to force the creation of a new connection instance

depth.title: Depth
depth.description: When browsing recursively into sub-types, what's the maximum search depth for diving into the tree. Default value notice: Maximum depth for browsing recursively (only if recursive = true)

direction.title: Direction
direction.description: The direction to browse (forward, inverse, ...). Default value notice: The direction to browse; see org.eclipse.milo.opcua.stack.core.types.enumerated.BrowseDirection

discoveryEndpointSuffix.title: Discovery Endpoint Suffix
discoveryEndpointSuffix.description: A suffix for endpoint URI when discovering

filter.title: Filter
filter.description: Filter out node ids to limit browsing. Default value notice: Regular filter expression matching node ids

includeSubTypes.title: Include Sub Types
includeSubTypes.description: Whether to include sub-types for browsing; only applicable for non-recursive browsing

maxNodeIdsPerRequest.title: Max Node Ids Per Request
maxNodeIdsPerRequest.description: The maximum number node ids requested per server call. Default value notice: Maximum number of node ids requested per browse call (applies to browsing sub-types only; only if recursive = true)

node.title: Node
node.description: The node definition (see Node ID). Default value notice: Root folder as per OPC-UA spec

nodeClasses.title: Node Classes
nodeClasses.description: The mask indicating the node classes of interest in browsing. Default value notice: Comma-separated node class list; see org.eclipse.milo.opcua.stack.core.types.enumerated.NodeClass

recursive.title: Recursive
recursive.description: Whether to browse recursively into sub-types, ignores includeSubTypes setting as it's implied to be set to true. Default value notice: Whether to recursively browse sub-types: truefalse

lazyStartProducer.title: Lazy Start Producer
lazyStartProducer.description: Whether the producer should be started lazy (on the first message). By starting lazy you can use this to allow CamelContext and routes to startup in situations where a producer may otherwise fail during starting and cause the route to fail being started. By deferring this startup to be lazy then the startup failure can be handled during routing messages via Camel's routing error handlers. Beware that when the first message is processed then creating and starting the producer may take a little time and prolong the total processing time of the processing.

allowedSecurityPolicies.title: Allowed Security Policies
allowedSecurityPolicies.description: A set of allowed security policy URIs. Default is to accept all and use the highest.

applicationName.title: Application Name
applicationName.default: Apache Camel adapter for Eclipse Milo

keyAlias.title: Key Alias
keyAlias.description: The name of the key in the keystore file

keyStoreUrl.title: Key Store Url
keyStoreUrl.description: The URL where the key should be loaded from

maxPendingPublishRequests.title: Max Pending Publish Requests
maxPendingPublishRequests.description: The maximum number of pending publish requests

maxResponseMessageSize.title: Max Response Message Size
maxResponseMessageSize.description: The maximum number of bytes a response message may have

overrideHost.title: Override Host
overrideHost.description: Override the server reported endpoint host with the host from the endpoint URI.

overridePort.title: Override Port
overridePort.description: Override the server reported endpoint port with the port from the endpoint URI.

requestedPublishingInterval.title: Requested Publishing Interval
requestedPublishingInterval.description: The requested publishing interval in milliseconds
